# Contributing to the Project

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Neuland Next!

The app and its open issues are primarily intended for members and contributors of Neuland Ingolstadt. We are also open to contributions from external contributors when they provide clear, meaningful value to the project.

We do not accept minimal or purely cosmetic changes. Before starting work, please ask to be assigned to an issue and wait for confirmation. This is especially important for issues labelled `good first issue`: although these tasks are intentionally easy to get started with, they are meant for human contributors to learn the project and are not intended as targets for automated pull requests. Pull requests for unassigned issues may be closed without review.

## How to Contribute

The contribution guidelines moved to the documentation site.\
Please refer to the [Contributing Guide](https://neuland.app/docs/contribute/contribute) for detailed instructions on how to contribute to this project.
